narrative.intro: B I obligated $254M in FY2026 to date through five awards, with an average award size of $50.8M and obligations up 33.4% year over year. B I's fiscal-year obligations show variability: FY21 was $281M, FY22 was $270M, FY23 was $314M, FY24 was $288M, FY25 was $190M, and FY26 is $254M so far. Facilities Support Services is the dominant market for B I, accounting for $247M of current-year obligations. Investigation and Personal Background Check Services is a much smaller market for B I, accounting for $6.5M. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Award-value tables use total contract values while other figures are contract obligations. This profile helps agencies and competitors quickly see B I's recent contract scale, its top NAICS markets, and the size and pace of its FY2026 obligations without projecting future performance.
